notes: Field Crafter 1.16.2 replaces the obsolete identity-gated player root with the direct local-player/Entity-table resolver validated on current Live and Open Beta.

Known inventory layouts are selected semantically: pre-patch +0x1428/+0x1478 and current Open Beta +0x1438/+0x1488. Capacity is read dynamically; level-50 values 170/80 are minimum sanity checks only.
Inventory totals are stack quantities and are no longer required to be <= slot capacity. Recipe and invention-salvage totals must reproduce their respective authoritative headers.
Schema-v1 memory packs remain readable for migration, while schema-v2 adds direct-player/entity-table locators and multiple known inventory layouts.
The signed GitHub application-update public configuration is intentionally unchanged from 1.16.1 so existing 1.16.1 installations can install 1.16.2 in place.
Windows user-profile path components are redacted from user-facing status/error text and shareable memory-diagnostic ZIPs, matching Auto-leveler privacy behavior.
Do not publish updates/manifest.json or memory/manifest.json from this development tree until final Windows artifacts/packs have been built, signed externally, and verified.
